scope: Synthetic helper repair only; no build or numerical campaign run.

causes_and_corrections.cause: Connected proof-face coverage accepted matching zero owned and surface face totals.
causes_and_corrections.correction: Require a positive reported surface-face count before coverage can pass.

causes_and_corrections.cause: The event reader selected rank_output/1 but did not reject additional launch roots or extra completed events.
causes_and_corrections.correction: Accept only the single rank_output/1 root, at most two complete event blocks, and ordinals one or two; leave an incomplete second block pending.

causes_and_corrections.cause: Repeated identical exit and final-timer records could inflate event ordinals.
causes_and_corrections.correction: Deduplicate identical parsed exit rows and timer snapshots before ordinal selection.

causes_and_corrections.cause: read_event selected the nth engine exit globally, but one native event can contain multiple engine exits, misaligning exit gates and M20/M21 diagnostics with remesh events.
causes_and_corrections.correction: Segment each rank log at its nth complete remesh/final timer summary, use the last exit within that segment, and collect diagnostics from the same segment; duplicate final snapshots remain counted once.

causes_and_corrections.cause: The final milestone sealer did not require the P7/P8 connected gates or F3b timer gates for both events.
causes_and_corrections.correction: Require all four event-specific receipts to exist, report passed=true, and carry their matching event ordinal.

causes_and_corrections.cause: The initial synthetic fixture referenced its root log before assigning the path.
causes_and_corrections.correction: Assign the fixture root path before writing the partial-event cases; reran the connected self-check successfully.

causes_and_corrections.cause: The duplicate-record fixture initially lacked event-distinguishing fields on exit rows and the full second root summary during duplication checks.
causes_and_corrections.correction: Give fixture exit rows event ordinals and restore the complete root log before injecting exact duplicates; reran successfully.

self_checks.event_one_two_engine_exits_event_two_exi: passed; event-one lower bounds selected as 550 after an earlier 1000 exit, event-two lower bounds selected as 575; event-two M20/M21 rows contain only event two

api_changes: check_connected_events.read_event now returns None for ambiguous roots, unsupported ordinals, or more than two completed event groups.
assess_complete_milestone.connected_receipts(case) returns {passed, records} for the four required event receipts.
